method:
Exercise generated regional mechanism entrances and physical verbs in mGBA.

Disclosed fixtures: fresh private SRAM and title seed; normal pending room
transitions for regional survey; hero position/standing/facing; owned equipment,
ammunition and one mineral-water bottle; player invulnerability while isolating
mechanism input. No Annex menu or direct handoff-room request is used. Actual
regional doors, tools, levers, body movement and vehicle controls produce all
mechanism, collision, completion and reward changes. No enemy HP/state,
completion/fusion bits, terrain, palette, VRAM, clock or pixels are assigned.

checks.name: actual generated mechanism room vocabulary
actual admitted field traversal stamps exist
field traversal 1 is the actual regional variant
field 1 has an actual dry collision-free perimeter
field 1 cache rejects an unearned crossing
upper deck is a real completed field crossing
field 1 crossing pays its actual cache
field 1 cache cannot pay twice
bridge ramp returns to ground plane
actual low-bank walk passes beneath bridge
underpass earns its separate twenty-gilt cache
underpass cache cannot pay twice
field traversal 2 is the actual regional variant
field 2 has an actual dry collision-free perimeter
field 2 cache rejects an unearned crossing
real R launches parachute from field ledge
controlled field descent reaches dry lower shelf
field 2 crossing pays its actual cache
field 2 cache cannot pay twice
red fusion has a physical field pool
unfused field island cannot yield its reward
real fuser A consumes half and raises field bridge
actual walking across fused bridge reaches island reward
